rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge State ownership of all legacy VID data
rfp_requirements.description: The State owns all data on the legacy VID and its related data structures; Contractor must acknowledge and respect this ownership throughout migration activities.

rfp_requirements.title: Distribute Apple-compatible iOS applications via State's App Store account
Provide Quality Management
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide Quality Management.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Issue Tracking System
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide an Issue Tracking System.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide secure internet access to ITS via approved browsers
rfp_requirements.description: Provide secure internet access to the ITS for multiple State-approved stakeholders through popular internet browsers such as Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Chrome.

rfp_requirements.title: Adhere to Deliverable Review and Change Timeline
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must adhere to the Deliverable Review and Change Timeline.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with State procedures/Circular Letter for property disposal
rfp_requirements.description: All removal/disposal of State property from a CIF must follow State procedures including Circular Letter No. 08-03-DPP and current applicable Circular guidance.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish contracts with external incident response specialists
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain contracts with external incident response services specialists.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop and implement compliance processes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must develop and implement processes ensuring compliance with all statutory, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy obligations applicable to the Contract (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, IRS-1075).

rfp_requirements.title: Restrict data transmission to authorized parties
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall only transmit or exchange State Data with other parties when expressly requested in writing and permitted by the Contract or the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Designate 24/7 breach contact individual
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must designate a single individual employed by Contractor available to the State 24 hours per day, 7 days per week as the incident response contact.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply cryptographic protections
rfp_requirements.description: Media protections must include application of cryptographic protections.

rfp_requirements.title: Restrict use of portable storage devices
rfp_requirements.description: Media protections must include restricting the use of portable storage devices.

rfp_requirements.title: Centralize remote access management
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must establish centralized management of the remote access infrastructure.

rfp_requirements.title: Record each CIF audit on the web portal
rfp_requirements.description: The auditor must record each audit on the web portal, including date of audit, CIF, and auditor's description.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct Covert Audits at CIFs
rfp_requirements.description: MVC shall conduct unannounced Covert Audits to ensure licensed inspectors follow all procedures and protocols set by the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge Entity License Data Source
rfp_requirements.description: License data for facilities, inspectors, and other entities is stored on tables generally updated from the MVC Business License System (BLS), covering approximately 20,000 licensed entities.

rfp_requirements.title: Set rulesVersion in Initialize Rule Sheet
rfp_requirements.description: Each ruleset must set the rulesVersion number in the initialize rule sheet and the rulesVersion should always be the same for all three rulesets even if unchanged.

rfp_requirements.title: Use Consistent Aliases in All Rule Sheets of a Ruleset
rfp_requirements.description: The aliases defined in the Scope section must be the same in all rule sheets in a ruleset and must always be used to identify attributes in the rule sheets.

rfp_requirements.title: Use inspExtentCode to Terminate Rulesets
rfp_requirements.description: The inspExtentCode is used to terminate a ruleset; almost all rule sheets check this attribute in Preconditions/Filters and if set to 'T', rule sheets will not execute.

rfp_requirements.title: Every Rule Sheet Must Have postInfo Entry in N.1
rfp_requirements.description: Every rule sheet must have a postInfo entry in row N.1 of the Rules (non-conditional) section, with Rule Statement equal to a dash followed by the rule sheet name.

rfp_requirements.title: Every Rules Conditions/Actions Column Must Have CurrInsp.post Row
rfp_requirements.description: Every Rules Conditions/Actions column must have a CurrInsp.post row in the Actions section to force tracking of which rules have fired, with the Rules Statement starting with the rule sheet name followed by a colon.

rfp_requirements.title: Lowering procedure - press yellow safety release and air valve
rfp_requirements.description: When lowering the jack, press the yellow safety release lever on the right side of the jack all the way down with the right hand while pushing the air valve lever to the left with the left hand to release air pressure.

rfp_requirements.title: Record each PIF audit on the web portal
rfp_requirements.description: The auditor must record each PIF audit on the web portal, including date, PIF, and auditor's description.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct automated record analysis
rfp_requirements.description: Record audits shall include automated record analysis to identify statistical inconsistencies, unusual patterns, and other discrepancies.

rfp_requirements.title: Check operation of all controls
rfp_requirements.description: During annual PM, check operation of all controls.

rfp_requirements.title: Remove washer/nut from inside anchor bolt locations
rfp_requirements.description: Remove the washer/nut from the two inside anchor bolt locations on each column for Challenger 4P12 & 4015.

rfp_requirements.title: Oil guide pins with jack at full height
rfp_requirements.description: Raise the jack to full height, oil the guide pins (do not grease), and lower the jack back down, repeating as necessary.

I-1. STATEMENT OF THE PROJECT
Pennsylvania operates one of the largest, longest-running decentralized Vehicle Emissions Inspection and Maintenance
(I/M) Programs in the United States. The Commonwealth’s I/M Program, divided into four regions, has grown to around
8,200 stations throughout 25 counties since 1997. PennDOT estimates nearly 7 million vehicles will be subject to
inspection by 2025. The Program design provides consumer convenience, supports private inspection stations, and
improves air quality. Stations in the Program are responsible for maintaining inspection equipment appropriate for the
required inspection types in the given region.
PennDOT is seeking a reliable, experienced Offeror to provide Emissions Program Management and continue the
successful operations of the I/M Program, overseeing safety inspection stations and related systems to keep consumer
and inspection station costs as low as possible while maintaining vehicle and consumer safety. The Program must
comply with federal and state requirements while providing adaptability for future Progr

l ensure the continued success of your Program through our strong foundational Program
knowledge and performance history of compliance and adaptability with no transition risk. We understand the need
for complete separation and no conflict of interest between PennDOT’s Emissions Program Manager and emissions
equipment providers. We are the only contractor that can guarantee no financial or business relationship with any
currently certified emissions testing equipment manufacturer in Pennsylvania.
The selected Program Manager will administer all aspects of the I/M Program under PennDOT’s direction, including the
required services defined in the RFP and outlined in work statement Part I-6. The contractor’s responsibilities include:
§ Maintaining the nature and scope of Pennsylvania’s current I/M Program
§ Maintaining required geographic coverage and program areas
§ Providing a seamless transition that prevents interruption in Program services or data collection by maintaining
interfaces with hardware and software and ensuring emission testing equipment transmits data to the Vehicle
Information Inspection Database (VIID) identically
§ Providing for the storage and handling of all I/M

d safety inspection data
§ Providing the necessary software/hardware to operate and maintain the I/M Program
§ Providing a disaster recovery plan
§ Providing data back-up and off-site back-up storage
§ Providing system journal files (transaction journals), logging all system transactions
§ Overseeing (overt, covert, and remote visual observation) I/M and Safety stations within the assigned geographic
region including inspectors and certified repair technicians
§ Conducting public information and education (I&E) activities relating to the I/M Program
§ Providing a process for investigation and fact-finding relating to I/M Program violations
§ Providing referee service to facilitate the resolution of consumer complaints
§ Helping I/M stations and consumers with the issuance of exemptions and waivers
§ Providing Help Desk facilities to address equipment manufacturer, I/M station, and consumer questions and
concerns regarding I/M Program requirements and to address system support issues for e-SAFETY users
§ Performing motorist compliance data collection and analysis
§ Collecting, organizing, storing, and reporting on data related to on-road testing (remote sensing)
§ Performing evaluat

nspection stations and personnel, primarily in I/M-affected counties throughout Pennsylvania
§ Providing a process for investigation and fact-finding regarding safety inspection regulation violations
